changes: Astra proposes ordered metric keyposes; local planning connects only the next pose.
observe_after stops the unexecuted suffix for fresh model feedback; partial sequence is not task success.
Visual robot silhouette and source-camera occlusion remove self hypotheses; fixed base overlap does not block new motion.
Strong observed obstacles reject; weak depth and unknown coverage are retained as explicit uncertainty with bounded-step execution.
Coherent payload surface avoids raw edge extrema; closure checks incremental measured finger motion.
Structured geometric failures reach Astra; colliding endpoints do not waste RRT budget.
Video distinguishes strong and uncertain planner geometry.
checks_note: One initial five-case file; only cases affected by subsequent actual fixes were rerun. No broad test matrix.
limitations: Saved input connections do not establish full-task success or collision freedom.
Weak geometry is traversable under bounded-step policy and remains uncertain.
Historical successful keypose is used only in offline diagnosis, not hardcoded in runtime or supplied as a live demonstration.
next_test: one T04 can obstacle, init0, seed7, gpt-6-astra high subscription, video and monitoring; pending explicit user approval
